title: SuperiorSkyBlock-Utils
description: This plugin adds many features in SuperiorSkyBlock which server owners want
body:
# 🌌 SuperiorSkyBlock-Utils

## 🧩 What is this?
**SuperiorSkyBlock-Utils** is a standalone plugin designed to enhance **SuperiorSkyblock** servers with quality-of-life features that make running a public Skyblock server smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable for players.

## 💡 Why did I create this plugin?
As a Skyblock server owner using **SuperiorSkyblock**, I realized there were a few small but important features missing that could make the experience feel more complete.  
This plugin fills those gaps — improving gameplay flow, automating common actions, and keeping players focused on Skyblock rather than wandering into unrelated worlds.

## ⚙️ Features
- **`/hub` or `/ishub` Command**  
  Instantly teleports players to the Skyblock hub. *(Currently defaults to the main hub world.)*

- **Automatic Greeting System (`GREET`)**  
  When a new player joins for the first time, the plugin automatically creates their island and sends a warm greeting message to everyone in that server:  
  `<PLAYER> joined for the first time!`
